Good questions. Clear answers.

New to Petaldew? Start here, then make the ritual your own.

Our formulas are created with comfort in mind and are suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. We still recommend patch testing any new product before full use.

Start with Essential Face Wash, follow with Hydrating Serum and Silk Eye Cream, then finish with moisturizer. Use the Silk Face Mask weekly or Rose Sleeping Mask as your final evening step.

Yes. Petaldew formulas are vegan, and our finished products and ingredients are not tested on animals.
